correctness.rationale: Verified every essential inference. Criticality holds: Z spans R^n, F spans 2-dim E; only {F} spans a proper subspace with dim 2=1+1, so C is critical not supercritical. Degenerate-pair vanishing V(M,N,C)=V(M,M,C)=V(N,N,C)=0 follows from Lemma 2.2 with witness {M,N,F} summing inside 2-dim E (<3 bodies). M not a translate of N (equal-length orthogonal centrally symmetric segments). Normalization V(M,B,C)=V(N,B,C) follows from reflection R=diag(1,-1,1,...) fixing B,Z,F and swapping M,N, with generator-permutation verified both by hand case analysis and by re-running verify_support.py. Multilinear expansion then gives V(K,L,C)=V(K,K,C)=V(L,L,C)=V(B,B,C)+2V(M,B,C)>=V(B,B,C)>0, with positivity from Lemma 2.2 since every subfamily containing B or Z spans R^n and {F} has dim 2>=1. Support membership of +-u*=+-(e1+e2)/sqrt2 and +-w*=+-(e1-e2)/sqrt2 via Lemma 2.3 was checked: orthogonal short roots span dimension n-1>=n-3, F-face is the surviving diagonal segment of dim 1, sum has dim n-1>=n-2, reproduced computationally for n=4,5,6. Support values hK=1+sqrt2,hL=1 at +-u* and swapped at +-w* force a=1+sqrt2 versus a=sqrt2-1=1/(1+sqrt2), a contradiction, so no (a,v) fits on supp S(B,C,.). K,L contain B hence full-dimensional. This is proof, not mere experiment.

Fused literature search (SerpBase/OpenAlex/Crossref/OpenAIRE, no partial failure) finds the general Shenfeld-van Handel theory (arXiv:2011.04059 / Acta 2023) and its Example 2.12 cube+square degenerate pair, but no prior source stating, tabulating, or implying this short-root zonotope tuple or its diagonal-segment degenerate pair. The general SvH theorem gives a criterion but does not decide any concrete tuple; Example 2.12 uses different reference bodies and different segments and does not imply the face-dimension support computation here (including the documented failed axis-aligned attempt). Synonymous-notation (D_n roots / B_n long roots), dual/complement encodings, broader censuses, and databases were screened with no covering result. Hence the concrete instantiation is substantively new, not a recomputation or corollary of a known stronger fact.
